AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
October 9, 2024
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

630 N. Angeleno Avenue (DR-2023-17, TPM-084537) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a request for a Design Review to allow for two (2) detached 3-story duplexes with attached parking on a 7,000 square-foot lot and a Tentative Parcel Map for the subdivision of the existing parcel into four (4) air parcels. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15332 (Class 32 ? Infill Development).
Item F-1
2.
555 W. Danlee Street (UP-2024-02) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Use Permit to allow for extended hours of operation from 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM for a construction contractor land use. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 ? Existing Facilities).
Item F-2
3.
628 N. Pasadena Avenue (DR-2022-28, TTM-084449) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Design Review to allow the construction of a 3-story, 6-unit condominium building with attached parking on a 7,700 square-foot lot and a Tentative Tract Map for the subdivision the existing parcel into six (6) air parcels. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15332 (Class 32 ? Infill Development).
Item F-3
4.
232 E. Foothill Blvd (UP-2024-03, MUP-2024-12, 13, & 14) ? The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider a Use Permit to allow for alcohol sales under a Type 41 alcohol license in conjunction with a restaurant and three (3) Minor Use Permits to allow for live entertainment, outdoor dining, and extended hours of operation, respectively. The proposed extended hours are Wednesdays and Thursdays from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM and Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM. The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1 ? Existing Facilities).
Item F-4
